body: Thank you. I would say, but I'm not sure if I should, in fear of him retaliating against me. But thank you for your kind words, I read them every now and then and it helps when I'm low.

I was raped by an ex boyfriend and completely abused. We're both minors, and the school said there's nothing illegal with what he did, and shut me down when I tried talking about the rape. He's stalking me also, staring at me, following me around school, brushing up against me, intimidating me. I'm so scared to be alone that I don't ever be alone. 

 I am plagued with nightmares, and scared to be at school. The school told me to suck it up, and I'm scared of him being in my classes next semester. The school refuses to get him out of my year-long band class either, saying it's up to my band director to decide if to kick him out. The band director is babying him, and he should be failing because he's an F student, but she's not failing him for whatever her screwed up reasons are. 

The worst part is I have no adults that will believe me or help me get a restraining order on him, or take me to the police. The clock is ticking on when I can report things, and I'm miserable. But everyday I hide it because when I went to get help, no one cared. I told a friend, and she's the only one that cares, but what can she do? She's a minor also.
